translations.web: Every meal offering of a priest shall be wholly burned. It shall not be eaten.”
translations.bsb: Every grain offering for a priest shall be burned completely; it is not to be eaten.”
translations.kjv: For every meat offering for the priest shall be wholly burnt: it shall not be eaten.
translations.asv: And every meal-offering of the priest shall be wholly burnt: it shall not be eaten.
